$comment: Known contrast misses in a clone theme's default colours, which copy its target's (CLAUDE.md clone rules). Only the default scheme can be listed here: every other scheme must pass. Each theme's Dark scheme fixes these.

arcade.onAccent/accent: the target's white on its blue
arcade.onFocus/focus: the target's white on its blue

orbit.onAccent/accent: the target's white on its lime

plaza.onAccent/accent: the target's white on its sky blue
plaza.onFocus/focus: the target's white on its sky blue
plaza.focus/background: the target's light blue focus on its white field

tide.text/surface: the target's translucent panels over its bright blue wave
